sentences.text: A whole bank, shipped one box at a time.
[pause] In nineteen sixteen, a town in Utah wanted a bank, and it didn't hire a builder.
Thousands of bricks were packed into parcels in Salt Lake City and posted out, box after box, [pause] until a whole bank had arrived one package at a time.
The clerks handling those boxes must have had questions.
[pause] Sometimes the strangest way to build something is to let the post office carry it.
